name: Use Monaco diff in CodeViewer
description:
Here is a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. A **Monaco Editor Vue wrapper component** (`Editor.vue`) was created supporting both a standard code editor and a diff editor mode.
2. The diff editor includes a **toolbar with toggle buttons** for side-by-side view, inline view, collapse unchanged regions, ignore whitespace, show indicators, and resizable split.
3. A **`diffEditorKey`** mechanism was implemented to force re-render the `DiffEditor` component whenever any option changes, ensuring Monaco picks up the new settings.
4. A **`CodeViewer.vue`** component was built on top of `Editor.vue`, handling file diffing, edit mode, syntax highlighting, stats loading, saving, copying, and sub-task creation.
5. The `CodeViewer` supports **three display modes**: a read-only syntax-highlighted view, an editable Monaco editor, and a side-by-side/inline diff view comparing disk content vs. generated code.

messages.content: Use monaco diff to show codeviewer diff

No need for read-only, allow edit the new code, main goal is to be able to recover changed or deleted lines from the original code.
Add the diff options in the top header so user can switch different modes like "side-by-side" or collapse/expand equal code.
Only monaco edit and diff will be used by codeviewer. 
Allow to save the changes done by diff.
The diff settings must be a header in Editor component and update editor options

All settings for diff Editor:
Core Diff OptionsrenderSideBySide: (boolean) Defaults to true (side-by-side view). Set to false to render a single-pane unified diff view.ignoreTrimWhitespace: (boolean) Defaults to true. Ignores changes in leading/trailing whitespace.renderIndicators: (boolean) Shows + or - indicators next to changed lines. Defaults to true.enableSplitViewResizing: (boolean) Allows the user to resize the split view in a side-by-side layout. Defaults to true.Behavior & ReadabilityreadOnly: (boolean) If true, the modified side cannot be edited. Defaults to false for the modified side, while the original side is always read-only.hideUnchangedRegions: (boolean) Hides unchanged parts of the file and only shows the differences, keeping the view clean for large files.originalEditable: (boolean) Allows editing directly in the original file (defaults to false).


When settings change the editor is not updating, make sure editor updates when settings change
